verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a public REST API with per-endpoint reference pages. The API covers inference (OpenAI-compatible chat completions) and automation of models, deployments, datasets, training and custom-model uploads. A published OpenAPI 3.1 'Gateway REST API' spec is listed in llms.txt. The probe's 404s only hit guessed paths, not the documented gateway.openapi.yaml location, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end programmatic control beyond first-party docs.
